Its narrowness (about 0.6) fits how far it sits below the top edge, which places it about 35–40° toward the viewer. The panels meet at the cap. Their seams curve outward around the ball and pinch together toward the hidden bottom pole. The blue panel faces the camera and is widest across the middle. The side panels narrow as they turn toward the outline, the red on the left and the green on the right in mirror image. The ball sinks slightly into the sand, and its shadow falls on the ground plane at the same top-down angle as the sand.
